caption: The kernel scans P's capability list: F1 fails the first comparison, F2 matches on comparison 2, and the read-write ticket's write bit is 1, so the open succeeds with no access-list check. A copy to a child needs the copy right, and revoking it later needs a shared handle.

spec.title: P's capability list: write on F2
spec.aria: Array of process P's three capabilities C1, C2 and C3; C2 for file F2 matches on the second object comparison and its write bit is 1, so access is allowed without an access-list lookup.
